channel.title: Central Seattle Dispatch
channel.description: Central Seattle news, once a week, from the Central Seattle Dispatch.

item.title: The council's budget committee votes Friday, Nov. 13, then Monday, Nov. 16, and Thursday, Nov. 19, each at 9:30 AM
item.description: The full council's final vote on the 2027–28 budget is set for a special meeting Friday, Nov. 20, at 1 PM, and the council notes the schedule can change.

item.title: Stevens and Montlake elementary schools are one of ten pairings Seattle Public Schools is weighing for possible mergers in 2027–28
item.description: The district says it will meet with families at the schools in November and December.

item.title: The Volunteer Park Conservatory's annual open house is Friday, Nov. 20, 5 to 7 PM, and it is free
item.description: It is the first look at the Seasonal House winter display, with a guest DJ. Conservatory

item.title: turn on City Light's outage texts before the next windstorm
item.description: City Light can text or email you about an outage at your address.

item.title: What the SR 520 work between I-5 and Montlake is building, and when it will be finished
item.description: A reader in Central Seattle asked what the SR 520 work between I-5 and Montlake is building, and when it will be finished.

item.title: Whether the eastbound SR 520 carpool lanes could change from three people to two
item.description: A reader in Central Seattle also asked whether the eastbound SR 520 carpool lanes could change from three people to two.

item.title: The budget chair's balancing package is scheduled for release Tuesday, Nov. 3, and the Budget Committee takes it up Wednesday, Nov. 4
item.description: The public hearing is Thursday, Nov. 5, with remote comment from 1 PM and in-person comment from 5 PM. The final council vote is Friday, Nov. 20, at 1 PM, and the council says the schedule can change.

item.title: Westbound SR 520 is listed as closed between Montlake Boulevard and I-5 on Nov. 13 through 16
item.description: WSDOT's Construction Corner lists the closure, and the work depends on weather, so check the map again closer to the date.

item.title: The RapidRide J Line open house now runs on the first Thursday of each month, and the next one is today, 2 to 3 PM
item.description: The session is on Microsoft Teams, and the project team also takes questions at its drop-in session.

item.title: check Seattle's tree rules before you prune
item.description: Before you prune or remove a tree on your own property, check Seattle's rules.

item.title: How to get speed bumps installed on a residential street in Seattle
item.description: A reader in Central Seattle asked how to get speed bumps installed on a residential street in Seattle.

item.title: The budget's final council vote is set for Friday, November 20, at 1 PM
item.description: After this week's amendment sessions, the chair's balancing package is published November 3 and presented November 4.

item.title: Election Day is Tuesday, November 3; drop boxes close at 8 PM
item.description: Vote centers are open 8:30 AM to 8 PM that day.

item.title: Clocks fall back one hour at 2 AM Sunday, November 1
item.description: Transit stays put: Metro's fall schedules, in effect since August 29, run through March 26, 2027, and Sound Transit's planned-work list shows nothing on the 1 Line through November 22.

item.title: You can ask the city for a curbside EV charger near your home
item.description: City Light and SDOT take applications for 12 months from this October, toward up to 200 public Level 2 curbside chargers.

item.title: SR 520's in-water piledriving season runs through April 30, 2027
item.description: WSDOT's third season started September 1, with intermittent piledriving across the project area, typically 8 AM to 5 PM on weekdays and 9 AM to 5 PM on weekends.

item.title: $50 off a smart thermostat for baseboard heat
item.description: If your home is heated by electric baseboards, wall fan heaters, hydronic baseboards or ceiling radiant heat on a line-voltage thermostat, Seattle City Light takes $50 off each smart thermostat, up to five per customer, through December 31, 2026, while funding lasts.

item.title: Where to find a solid blues bar in or near Central Seattle, ideally a full band in a seated room
item.description: A reader asked where to find a solid blues bar in or near Central Seattle, ideally a full band in a seated room.

item.title: SR 520's westbound ramps to northbound I-5 and E Roanoke St close nightly again, October 26–29
item.description: WSDOT closes them 10 PM to 6 AM, Monday through Thursday.

item.title: The budget's road to the November 5 hearing
item.description: The Select Budget Committee takes oral comment Tuesday, October 27, at 9:30 AM, then discusses councilmembers' proposals October 27 to 29.

item.title: Ballots are due Tuesday, November 3
item.description: No stamp is needed.

item.title: Late-night Link: buses may replace 2 Line trains after 11 PM on October 31 and November 1
item.description: Rail milling on the 2 Line may need a bus bridge between Judkins Park and International District/Chinatown stations.

item.title: The chrysanthemum show comes to the Volunteer Park Conservatory, October 30 to November 1
item.description: The Evergreen Chrysanthemum Association, a club founded in 1947, shows hundreds of large exhibition mums from Friday at 11 AM to Sunday at 3 PM, free with admission.

item.title: free leaf bags all November
item.description: In November, Seattle Public Utilities picks up up to 10 extra bags of leaves for free on each collection day for household food and yard waste customers.

item.title: The city's $9.1 billion budget gets its last public hearing November 5, and one line is a park at the Arboretum's north end
item.description: The mayor's proposed 2027–28 budget is with the council's Select Budget Committee.

item.title: SR 520's westbound ramps to northbound I-5 and E Roanoke St close nightly, Monday through Thursday, two weeks running
item.description: WSDOT closes them 10 PM to 6 AM on October 19–22 and October 26–29.

item.title: No 2 Line trains between International District/Chinatown and South Bellevue this weekend
item.description: Shuttle buses replace them Saturday and Sunday, October 17–18, every 10 to 15 minutes, a stretch that includes Judkins Park station; the 1 Line through Capitol Hill station runs about every 8 minutes.

item.title: November 2, not October 31
item.description: The second half of 2026 King County property tax is due Monday, November 2.
